categories.main_business_segments: Xiangyu Medical primarily operates in the rehabilitation medical device industry, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and service of rehabilitation medical equipment. The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering rehabilitation physiotherapy, training, nursing, aids, assessment, traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment, health care, medical aesthetics, rehabilitation furniture, and home rehabilitation. It provides integrated clinical rehabilitation solutions and professional technical support services to medical institutions, elderly care facilities, disability rehabilitation centers, welfare institutions, educational systems, and families across China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technological innovation with core technologies in shockwave therapy, magnetic therapy, phototherapy, electrotherapy, robotics, brain-computer interfaces (BCI), AI medical applications, and multi-physical factor integrated therapy. It has developed proprietary technologies such as intelligent rehabilitation robots, non-invasive BCI devices, AI-driven rehabilitation decision engines, and modular integrated rehabilitation equipment. Production follows strict quality management systems including ISO13485 and integrates digital manufacturing platforms like ERP, MES, CRM, and PLM to enhance efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xiangyu Medical serves a broad range of customers including hospitals at all levels, rehabilitation centers, elderly care institutions, disability rehabilitation centers, welfare institutions, educational systems, sports systems, military units, and individual consumers for home rehabilitation. The company targets clinical rehabilitation markets such as pain management, orthopedics, neurological rehabilitation, post-operative recovery, cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, mental health rehabilitation, traditional Chinese medicine rehabilitation, and elderly care. It also actively expands into international markets, especially countries along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales coverage across 31 provincial-level administrative regions and a strong presence in central, eastern, northern, northwestern, southwestern, southern, and northeastern China. It has established multiple R&D centers in cities including Zhengzhou, Tianjin, Nanjing, Chengdu, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Xi'an. Internationally, Xiangyu Medical exports products to over 30 countries and regions, including Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Central Asia, South America, and Africa, and participates in global medical device exhibitions in Germany and Dubai.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiangyu Medical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the rehabilitation medical device supply chain. It undertakes independent research and development, manufacturing, and sales of rehabilitation medical devices. The company also provides integrated clinical rehabilitation solutions and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive supplier and service provider within the rehabilitation medical device industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on technological innovation, with significant investment in R&D accounting for over 20% of revenue. Key R&D directions include brain-computer interface technology, rehabilitation robotics, AI medical applications, and multi-physical factor integrated therapies. Xiangyu Medical pursues a 'technology innovation-driven' approach, emphasizing产学研用 (industry-academia-research-application) integration, expanding R&D centers nationwide, and collaborating with top universities and research institutes to accelerate technology transfer and product commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Xiangyu Medical generates revenue primarily through the sale of rehabilitation medical devices and related products. Sales are conducted mainly via indirect channels (distributors and agents) and direct sales to end customers including medical institutions and individual consumers. The company also engages in e-commerce sales targeting home rehabilitation users. Revenue streams include product sales, technical service fees, and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xiangyu Medical is positioned as a leading R&D-driven enterprise in China's rehabilitation medical device industry, with a comprehensive product portfolio and strong market coverage. It holds a top ranking (TOP2) in China’s medical device R&D strength. The company benefits from extensive patent holdings, national-level certifications, and industry awards, distinguishing itself from competitors through innovation, integrated solutions, and broad clinical application coverage. It competes with domestic and international rehabilitation device manufacturers but maintains a competitive edge through technology leadership and scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, Xiangyu Medical reported annual revenue of approximately RMB 743.5 million, with a slight year-on-year decrease of 0.17%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 102.9 million, down 54.68% compared to the previous year, mainly due to increased R&D personnel costs and depreciation from new projects. Total assets grew by 12.95% to RMB 2.93 billion, while net assets slightly decreased by 2.5% to RMB 2.04 billion. The company maintains a stable dividend payout ratio around 35.95% and actively repurchases shares to enhance shareholder value.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiangyu Medical emphasizes its comprehensive, integrated rehabilitation solutions that cover a full spectrum of clinical needs and patient populations. Its value proposition lies in advanced proprietary technologies such as brain-computer interfaces, intelligent rehabilitation robots, and AI-driven personalized rehabilitation programs. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, multi-disciplinary technology integration, and a robust nationwide sales and service network. It also offers one-stop lifecycle services including product development, manufacturing, clinical training, and after-sales support, ensuring high-quality, effective rehabilitation outcomes.
